title: estate.news.story
description: One story from the estate newsroom (crew#974 P1). The voice-router director (VOICE_MODE=director) publishes it on subject estate.news.story.<channel> in JetStream stream ESTATE_NEWS, and also on estate.news.story.news when score >= 3 or breaking. Headlines and anchors are deterministic templates; no LLM is used in P1.

id.description: the same id is re-published when a story is deduplicated

supersedes.description: the id of the story this one corrects, present only when state=corrected

channel.description: which channel this story belongs to

severity.description: it only escalates within one story

anchor.description: one sentence on why it matters, naming the source, e.g. 'according to Flux'

link.description: a link to more detail on this story

score.description: sevWeight(info 1, warn 3, danger 9) x 0.5^(age/10min) x (2 if count==1 else 1)

count.description: how many times this entity's story has recurred

breaking.description: danger, or a CI failure with count >= 3

first_at.description: when this story's entity was first reported

at.description: when this story row was last updated

examples.headline: FAILED: ns-fences, 3rd in 12m
examples.anchor: ns-fences is not reconciling (BuildFailed), so its changes are not reaching the cluster, according to Flux.
evidence: BuildFailed: kustomize build failed: accumulating resources

examples.headline: RECOVERED: ns-fences
examples.anchor: ns-fences is reconciling again, so its changes are reaching the cluster, according to Flux.
